Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9 Gaming Laptop (Intel Core i5-12600HX / 24GB DDR5 / 512GB SSD / RTX 3050 6GB / 144Hz IPS)

Supercharge your gaming and multitasking performance with the upgraded Lenovo LOQ 15IAX9 gaming laptop, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. This high-performance machine is powered by the robust Intel Core i5-12600HX processor and paired with a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB GDDR6 graphics card, offering smooth gameplay and support for advanced AI features. Custom configured with a massive 24GB of high-speed DDR5 memory, this laptop layout eliminates lag during heavy streaming and intense creation workloads, while the 512GB NVMe PCIe SSD ensures ultra-fast boot times. Visuals look crisp and fluid on the 15.6-inch Full HD (1920x1080) IPS display profile, featuring a fast 144Hz refresh rate for tear-free competitive gameplay. Complete with Lenovo's advanced thermal design to keep system setups icy cool, this premium computing pack is backed by a 2-year official agency warranty layout.
